G4196.name: Publius
G4196.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G4196.brief: Chief official of Malta who hosted Paul
G4196.short: Publius, the chief official of Malta, who hosted Paul and his companions for three days after their shipwreck on the island.

G4195.name: Pontus
G4195.brief: A region in Asia Minor with Jewish inhabitants
G4195.short: Pontus was a region in Asia Minor along the Black Sea coast, home to Jewish inhabitants and early Christian converts.
